item.title: Devin Booker: Nets game-high 33 points in loss
item.description:
Booker finished with 33 points (9-19 FG, 2-8 3Pt, 13-13 FT), one rebound, two assists and two turnovers across 34 minutes in Wednesday's 132-119 loss to the Trail Blazers.

item.title: Victor Wembanyama: Posts monster double-double in win
item.description:
Wembanyama went off for 52 points (16-28 FG, 1-8 3Pt, 19-23 FT), 24 rebounds, two assists, two steals and eight blocks over 34 minutes in Wednesday's 112-111 win over the Mavs.

item.title: LaMelo Ball: Nets 20 points with four stocks in win
item.description:
Ball totaled 20 points (6-11 FG, 4-7 3Pt, 4-5 FT), two rebounds, six assists, three steals, one block and seven turnovers across 31 minutes in Wednesday's 117-107 win over the Rockets.

item.title: Keyonte George: Erupts for 39 points with nine dimes
item.description:
George registered 39 points (14-26 FG, 2-9 3Pt, 9-13 FT), two rebounds, nine assists, four steals and one block over 44 minutes in Wednesday's 120-113 overtime loss to the Pelicans.

item.title: Vit Krejci: Suffers leg fracture
item.description:
Head coach Micah Nori said that Krejci suffered a left leg fracture during Wednesday's 132-119 win over the Suns, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.
